title: At-Tahiyyat
intro: In every sitting of Salah we greet and thank Allah with At-Tahiyyat.

learn.html: At-Tahiyyat shows our thanks and obedience to Allah. We say it in every sitting of Salah:

learn.label: At-Tahiyyat
learn.ar: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
learn.tr: At-tahiyyaatu lillaahi was-salawaatu wat-tayyibaatu. As-salaamu ‘alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullaahi wa barakaatuh. As-salaamu ‘alaynaa wa ‘alaa ‘ibaadillaahis-saaliheen. Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illallaah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan ‘abduhu wa rasooluh.
learn.en: Greetings, prayers and good words belong to Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and Allah’s mercy and blessings. Peace be upon us and on all of Allah’s good servants. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is Allah’s servant and Messenger.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: At-Tahiyyat is the conversation between Allah and the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) on the Mi‘raj. Our sincere prayers are our own mi‘raj – our closeness to our Lord.
Listen and repeat: At-Tahiyyatu, Salawat and Duas.
